scope: Predicts channel, committed_count, or committed_sum for a fresh action sequence by enumerating the disclosed 18-member SQLite family and keeping only members consistent with all calibration receipts.
lesson: The family is small enough to enumerate: put mode (IGNORE/REPLACE/UPSERT), trigger presence, and channel (changes/total_changes main/total_changes both). Simulate each member against every receipt, discard inconsistent ones, and answer only when all survivors agree on the goal.
